title: Invoice discrepancy samples — Feb 2026 (invoice vs usage export)
body:
Purpose
- Working sample set for Feb 2026 reconciliation: compares invoice line item meters vs customer usage exports (Usage API) at account/day/model/region granularity.
- This is not a full population report; it’s a targeted set used to classify failure modes and decide remediation (credit, forward fix, backfill, invoice hold).

Notes on interpretation
- invoice_billed_* is what posted to the billing ledger for the invoice preview run.
- usage_export_billed_* is what the customer-facing usage export (Usage API) shows for the same day/model/region when pulled on 2026-02-24.
- When “late events” is suspected: the ledger may include late-arriving usage events that were missing from the Usage API export at pull time OR vice-versa depending on backfill timing.
- Currency deltas are approximate; price book varied by plan/commit and is not re-derived here. Treat delta_usd as directional for triage.

Summary (as of 2026-02-26)
- Samples: 22
- By discrepancy_type:
  - Retry/fallback double-counting (streaming + server retry): 5
  - Missing/incorrect region dimension (mis-priced region or rolled-up “unknown”): 4
  - Embeddings batch accounting bug (multi-input batch): 3
  - Credits application timing (invoice vs credit memo mismatch): 3
  - Timezone misalignment (daily export day boundary): 3
  - Cache-hit attribution missing/changed billed token fields: 2
  - Dedicated GPU usage (idle/autoscale transitions; v1 vs v2): 2

Open questions / follow-ups
- For samples marked “Maybe” Finance action: align on threshold and customer criteria for adjusting next invoice vs issuing immediate credit memo (see slack://finance/1770178450-audit-trail-requirements-for-meter-changes).
- For region issues: confirm whether mis-tagged region changes price (some enterprise contracts have unified rate by region).
- For retry double-counting: ensure PR-27463 + idempotency hardening PR-27555 are both deployed in all regions before closing out root cause.
